ICMR has launched an infectious disease surveillance network intended to give early warning of outbreaks.
The Centre proposes expanding Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY government hospital treatment packages from 23 to 112.
India, together with Bangladesh, has banned a toxic pesticide as part of suicide prevention and brain health efforts.
India is moving to standardise registration of allied healthcare professionals, with new rules on skills and qualifications.
At the BIMSTEC meeting India proposed joint research and a traditional medicine hub among member countries.
Health Minister Nadda called for digital health cooperation among BIMSTEC countries at the Colombo meeting.
